career_ladder.note: State Bank of India Specialist Cadre Officers (SCO) enter as lateral domain specialists in Corporate Credit, SME Credit, and Credit Risk Management. Officers advance through Middle Management, Senior Management, and Top Executive Grades subject to minimum residency, performance appraisal, and promotion committee review.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for SBI Specialist Cadre Officers (Credit Analyst) is conducted through an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. In cycles where applicant volumes are limited relative to notified posts, SBI exercises its statutory prerogative to shortlist candidates directly based on qualifications and post-qualification experience for the Interview.

financial_package.pay_source_label: 12th Bipartite Settlement & Joint Note on Bank Officer Scales (IBA & SBI), Middle Management Grade Scale III (₹85,920 - 2,680/5 - 99,320 - 2,980/2 - 1,05,280)
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay is set per the 12th Bipartite Settlement (Scale III entry basic ₹85,920). Dearness Allowance is adjusted quarterly per CPI-IW; in addition, bank officers receive Special Allowance (with DA thereon), Learning Allowance, City Compensatory Allowance, and Bank leased accommodation (or HRA). Deductions include Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) and income tax.
official_perks: Bank leased residential accommodation or House Rent Allowance across major commercial centers
Special Allowance and Learning Allowance per Bipartite settlement
Concessional housing loan, car loan, and personal loans as per SBI Staff Rules
Comprehensive medical insurance and cashless treatment in empanelled multi-specialty hospitals
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) / Home Travel Concession with leave encashment benefits
Monthly reimbursements for official conveyance / petrol, telephone / broadband, and newspapers

competition_benchmarks.note: SBI Specialist Cadre Officer recruitments require mandatory professional credentials (Chartered Accountant, MBA Finance, CFA, or FRM) along with documented post-qualification experience in corporate credit appraisal and risk evaluation, resulting in targeted applicant pools compared to general banking exams.
